sections.label: Hawker hardship and burdens
sections.summary: The passage states not enough is done for hawkers burdened by cheap food demands, high rent, harsh conditions and predatory management.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Not enough is done to address the hardship of our hawkers, who are burdened with the need to provide cheap food to the public, high rent, harsh work environment and arguably predatory management practices in the social enterprise hawker centres.

sections.label: Government hawker centre management
sections.summary: No new hawker centres were built from 1986 to 2011, and besides the social enterprise model little has changed in government management.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The Government did not build any new hawker centres from 1986 until 2011.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Since then, many Singaporeans, including those who know the hawker trade, have stepped forward to contribute good ideas to better support hawkers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: However, besides the introduction of the social enterprise model, officially called the Socially-conscious Enterprise Hawker Centre (SEHC) model, not much else has fundamentally changed about the way the Government manages hawkers.

sections.label: Thai restaurants overseas growth
sections.summary: Thai restaurants overseas tripled from about 5,000 in 2002 to 15,000 in 2024, largely due to strong government support.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The number of Thai restaurants overseas has tripled from about 5,000 in 2002 to 15,000 in 2024.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: But a large part of their success is due to strong government support, such as in training chefs, providing loans and conducting market research to advise chefs on how to appeal to foreign tastes.

sections.label: Challenges to sustaining hawker culture
sections.summary: The passage says hawker culture's sustainability is uncertain due to four challenge areas: management, costs, working conditions and cheap food expectations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: We do not know how long more we can sustain our hawker culture because of the many challenges faced by hawkers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: These challenges can be grouped into four areas: one, hawker centre management, which includes problems with the social enterprise hawker centre model; two, high rent and other operating costs; three, harsh working conditions leading to shortage of manpower and successors; and four, the expectation to provide cheap food, which is partly encouraged by the Government.

sections.label: Social enterprise hawker centre costs
sections.summary: Median rent at social enterprise hawker centres is about 5% higher than NEA centres, and auxiliary costs can equal the rent.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Based on replies to my past Parliamentary Questions (PQs), we know that the median rent at social enterprise hawker centres is about 5% higher than the median rent at NEA-operated hawker centres.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: However, auxiliary costs at the social enterprise hawker centres, such as table cleaning fees, dishwashing fees, Service and Conservancy Charges (S&CCs) and pest control fees, can add up to as much as the rent itself.

sections.label: Stall early termination rates
sections.summary: From 2019 to 2023, average annual early termination rate was 8% at social enterprise hawker centres versus 3% at NEA centres.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: From 2019 to 2023, the average annual early termination rate for food stalls at social enterprise hawker centres was 8%, more than twice as high as the 3% early termination rate at NEA-operated hawker centres.

sections.label: Phasing out social enterprise model
sections.summary: The PSP recommends phasing out the current social enterprise model as current operators' contracts expire.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The PSP recommends that the current social enterprise model be phased out, as the contracts of the current operators expire.

sections.label: Hawker stall rents and bids
sections.summary: In 2023 the median monthly rent for non-subsidised stalls at NEA hawker centres was $1,625, with bids often higher.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: In 2023, the median monthly rent for non-subsidised stalls at NEA-operated hawker centres was $1,625 per month but bids frequently exceeded that, especially for stalls in better locations with higher footfall.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: One successful tender recently exceeded $10,000 per month.

sections.label: Record Yishun coffee shop price
sections.summary: In 2022 Chang Cheng Mee Wah Group set a record $9,361 per square foot buying a Yishun coffee shop for $40 million.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: A record price of $9,361 per square foot was set in 2022 by the Chang Cheng Mee Wah Group when it bought a Yishun coffee shop for $40 million.

sections.label: Base rent and random ballot
sections.summary: Under this rent model stalls pay a $500 monthly base rent or 3% of gross turnover, whichever is higher, allocated by random ballot.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Under this rent model, all hawker stalls will be charged a monthly base rent of $500 or 3% of gross turnover, whichever is higher.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Stalls will be allocated by a random ballot within each food category curated by Hawker Singapore under the advice of the independent industry panel.

sections.label: Work Permit holder stall assistants
sections.summary: The PSP recommends each cooked food hawker stall be allowed to employ one Work Permit holder as a stall assistant.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: In this case, a Work Permit holder will complement our current hawkers without threatening the job security of Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Therefore, PSP recommends that each cooked food hawker stall, including drinks and cut fruit stalls, should be allowed to employ one Work Permit holder as a stall assistant.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: PSP also believes that the recent move by the Government to allow hawkers to employ Long-Term Visit Pass (LTVP) holders as stall assistants will not be adequate to address the manpower problems of the hawkers.

sections.label: Budget meals requirement
sections.summary: Social enterprise hawker centres and some HDB coffee shops force stallholders to sell budget meals, usually at $3 or $3.50.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Social enterprise hawker centres and some HDB coffee shops already contractually force stallholders to sell budget meals, usually at $3 or $3.50.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: By 2026, all stalls in rental HDB coffee shops will be required to sell these budget meals.

sections.label: Government paying food discounts
sections.summary: The Government should ensure affordable food and pay for Pioneer, Merdeka and CHAS cardholder discounts, for example through the Pioneer or Merdeka Generation Funds.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: It is the Government’s responsibility to ensure that food remains affordable.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: We propose that discounts for Pioneer, Merdeka and CHAS cardholders should be paid for the Government, for example through the funds in the Pioneer or Merdeka Generation Funds.

sections.label: Complaints about food prices
sections.summary: Most of the hundreds of complaints about price increases received by the Committee Against Profiteering are about food prices.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hazel Poa (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Out of the hundreds of complaints about price increases received by the Committee Against Profiteering, most are about food prices.

sections.label: Hawker stall rent structure
sections.summary: Hawker food deserves special consideration, so stall allocation should not be based on highest rent tendered but on a pre-determined rent structure to control rental cost.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hazel Poa (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: We believe that hawker food qualifies as another case deserving special consideration.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hazel Poa (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: We have therefore proposed that the allocation of hawker stalls should not be based on highest rent tendered.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hazel Poa (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Instead, we propose a pre-determined rent structure to keep rental cost under control.

sections.label: Government paying targeted hawker discounts
sections.summary: PSP believes the Government, not hawkers, should ensure affordable food, so the Government should pay for targeted hawker centre discounts for Pioneer, Merdeka and CHAS cardholders and lower-income households.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hazel Poa (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Next, I want to reiterate that PSP firmly believes that it should be the Government’s responsibility to ensure that food remains affordable, not the hawkers'.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hazel Poa (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: We therefore propose that, instead of compelling hawkers to offer budget meals to everyone at their own cost, the Government should pay for targeted food discounts at hawker centres for Pioneer, Merdeka and CHAS cardholders, and lower-income households.

sections.label: Centralised hawker ingredient procurement
sections.summary: Hawkers pay for the budget meal initiative though many are lower-income, so a new agency, Hawker Singapore, could contract wholesalers to supply common ingredients at lower bulk-purchase prices.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hazel Poa (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: As my colleague Mr Leong Mun Wai has explained, the “budget meal” initiative is being paid for by hawkers themselves, but many of them are themselves lower-income Singaporeans who are not in a good position to pay for such initiatives.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hazel Poa (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: We can set up a centralised procurement system where the new agency, Hawker Singapore, can contract with wholesalers to supply hawkers with ingredients that are commonly used by hawkers, such as cooking oil, rice, flour, sugar, salt and eggs, at lower prices through bulk purchasing.

sections.label: Hawker Singapore and stall rent
sections.summary: The proposals are to phase out social enterprise hawker centres and centralise management under a new agency, Hawker Singapore, and to set rent at $500 monthly or 3% of turnover, whichever is higher.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hazel Poa (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: First, we propose to gradually phase out social enterprise hawker centres and centralise the management of all hawker centres under a new Government agency called Hawker Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hazel Poa (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Second, we propose to stop the current practice of awarding stalls to the highest bidder.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hazel Poa (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: We suggest setting the rent at $500 per month or 3% of total turnover, whichever is higher.

sections.label: Work Permit hawker assistants
sections.summary: The proposal asks the Government to let hawkers hire one Work Permit holder as a hawker assistant to ease manpower shortages.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hazel Poa (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Third, we propose that the Government allow hawkers to hire one Work Permit holder as a hawker assistant to alleviate manpower shortages.

sections.label: Centralised hawker ingredient procurement
sections.summary: The proposal asks the Government to set up a centralised procurement system contracting wholesalers to supply hawkers common ingredients at bulk prices.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hazel Poa (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Fifth, we propose that the Government establish a centralised procurement system, contracting with wholesalers to supply hawkers with commonly used ingredients such as cooking oil, rice, flour, sugar, salt and eggs at bulk prices.

sections.label: Government organising street hawkers
sections.summary: After 1965 the Government licensed and organised 18,000 street hawkers into safe trading spaces, and with HDB planned hawker services into estates.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: Indeed, it was this Government, right after our Independence in 1965, that recognised the collective value of our street hawkers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: This Government rolled up its sleeves and started the hard work of licensing and organising our 18,000 street hawkers into safe trading spaces with access to water, storage and sanitation.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: It was also this Government, together with the HDB in the 1970s, that did something quite extraordinary and innovative.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: While organizing street hawkers, the HDB had the eureka moment of also planning, into our HDB estates, nearby access to organised hawker services, thereby sparking the Singaporean hawker culture that we all know and love today.

sections.label: Hawkers' long working hours
sections.summary: Many hawkers wake at 3.30 am to prepare ingredients, open before 7.00 am, and close only after the last evening customer leaves.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: Many hawker brothers and sisters have to wake up at 3.30 am to start preparing ingredients, so they can open their stalls before 7.00 am to serve residents going to work and school, and they can only close after the last customer leaves in the evening.

sections.label: Hawker business pressures
sections.summary: Hawkers face long hours, rising business costs, an ageing workforce and cost-of-living pressures, with raw material costs rising up to 40%.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: Our hawkers and F&B owners have spoken: long hours, rising business costs, an ageing workforce and pressures from costs of living are at the top of the mind for our hawkers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: Hawkers have told me that they face up to 40% increases in raw material costs and many are still calibrating with their service providers on keeping the costs down.

sections.label: Centralised dishwashing bowl charges
sections.summary: Wei Siang said stall owners pay a monthly dishwashing service fee plus a standardised per-bowl rate of about 10 to 20 cents or more.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: I learnt from Wei Siang, who has recently quit his job as a cabin crew to join his family's business selling Ah Balling at our One Punggol Hawker Centre, that in the business model of centralised dish washing, prevalent at many hawker centres now, that the stall owner would likely need to pay, on top of a monthly service fee for dishwashing, a standardised rate for each bowl that is being used.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: This means, for every empty bowl that a patron of the stall requests from the stall owner, the stall owner would incur another around 10 cents, 20 cents, maybe more, per bowl charged to them by the dishwashing vendor.

sections.label: Free bowls and chargeable bowl caps
sections.summary: Chye Thiam Maintenance provides 100 free bowls topped up at peak periods, and NTUC Foodfare capped chargeable bowls for hawkers after feedback.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: Chye Thiam Maintenance, for example, provides 100 free bowls for patrons which they put at different collection points in a hawker centre and tops this up during peak periods.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: NTUC Foodfare, after receiving feedback, has also put a hard cap on chargeable bowls for hawkers.

sections.label: Xi De Li you char kway production
sections.summary: Xi De Li moved from street vending to hawker centres, took on you char kway OEM contracts, and now produces 10,000 sticks daily.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: Xi De Li moved from street vending into hawker centres and over the years, took on you char kway OEM contracts, supplying to other stalls and restaurants.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: They now have their own factory producing 10,000 sticks of you char kway daily.

sections.label: Everyone supporting hawkers and hawker culture
sections.summary: The passage calls on the Government, Singaporeans, the Labour Movement, operators and service providers to explore new ways to support hawkers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: The second point is, everyone, not just the Government, has a part to play in supporting our hawkers and sustaining and growing our hawker culture.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: I call on the Government, Singaporeans, the Labour Movement, operators and service providers, to continue exploring new and innovative ways in which we can support our hawkers.

sections.label: Hawkerpreneur cost breakdown at Senja
sections.summary: Hawkerpreneurs at Senja Hawker Centre said ingredients are 50% to 60% of costs, manpower 15% to 25%, and rental around 10%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: Based on data shared by hawkerpreneurs whom I met recently at Senja Hawker Centre, ingredients make up 50% to 60% of their total costs, manpower accounts for 15% to 25% and rental constitutes around 10%.

sections.label: Hawker net profit margin per serving
sections.summary: The actual net profit margin hawkers earn is as low as 20 cents to 40 cents per serving.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: The actual net profit margin that our hawkers earn is as low as 20 cents to 40 cents per serving.

sections.label: Rising chicken and chilli costs
sections.summary: Mr Zuhairi shared that since COVID-19 fresh chicken rose from $3.50 to $4.50 per kilogramme and chilli nearly tripled.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: Mr Zuhairi also shared that in recent years since COVID-19, the cost of fresh chicken has risen from $3.50 to $4.50 per kilogrammes and the price of chilli has nearly tripled, from $2.50 to $6 per kilogrammes.

sections.label: Hawker stall assistant salaries
sections.summary: Hawkers offer stall assistants $2,600 to $3,200, but few local jobseekers want these demanding, long-hour positions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: Hawkers are now offering salaries ranging from $2,600 to $3,200 for stall assistants, but there are very few local jobseekers interested in these positions, due to the demanding nature of the work and long hours.

sections.label: LTVP+ holders hired by hawkers
sections.summary: After the member's August Parliamentary Question, Dr Koh Poh Koon announced hawkers can now employ LTVP+ holders as stall assistants.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: As a follow-up, I submitted a Parliamentary Question in August, urging the Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment (MSE) to allow hawkers to hire LTVP+ holders.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: I am pleased that following this, Senior Minister of State Dr Koh Poh Koon announced in the last Sitting, that hawkers can now employ LTVP+ holders as stall assistants.

sections.label: Foreign worker limits in hawker centres
sections.summary: NEA allows hawkers a limited number of foreign assistants under conditions, and the LTVP+ policy shows continuous review of manpower and culture.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: To strike a balance, NEA allows hawkers to employ a limited number of foreign workers as assistants, subject to certain conditions to ensure that the character of hawker centres is maintained." Member Lim Biow Chuan expressed during the 5 March 2010 Sitting, "Many residents have given feedback that the presence of foreign workers affects the traditional feel of our hawker centres.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: The recent policy to enable hawkers to hire LTVP+ holders demonstrates that reviews are conducted continuously, taking the manpower situation and cultural attitudes into careful consideration.

sections.label: Hawker meal versus median wage
sections.summary: A hawker meal is about 0.1% of Singapore's 2023 median monthly wage, compared with Kuala Lumpur's wage and street food price.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: In Singapore, the median monthly wage in 2023 is about $5,197 and a typical hawker meal costs around $5.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: This means that a hawker meal represents roughly 0.1% of the median monthly income.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: Consider Kuala Lumpur in Malaysia, where the median monthly wage in the same year is approximately $1,901 and a street food meal costs about $2.90.

sections.label: Urban Hawker New York prices
sections.summary: Reports say chicken rice and prawn mee at Urban Hawker in New York cost about $25 and $26, more than in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: It is laudable that our hawker food has been brought overseas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: However, I read in a report by local news site Mothership and also CNA, that chicken rice and prawn mee sold by Urban Hawker in New York cost about $25 and $26, much more than the same dishes cost in Singapore.

sections.label: Vouchers at Senja Hawker Centre
sections.summary: Hawkerpreneurs at Senja Hawker Centre said vouchers contributed about 10% of their revenue, which is significant.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: Hawkerpreneurs at Senja Hawker Centre shared that these vouchers contributed to approximately 10% of their revenue, which is significant.

sections.label: Zhenghua $1 hawker meals
sections.summary: Zhenghua residents can buy $1 deals monthly, with nearly 1,000 hawker meals sold at $1 each in December, and community funds topping up the difference.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: Every month, Zhenghua residents can purchase $1 deals and in December alone, nearly 1,000 hawker meals were sold at just $1 each.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: Hawkers receive the full value of the meal as our community funds tops up the difference.

sections.label: DBS hawker meals programme
sections.summary: DBS' "5 Million Hawker Meals" programme offers $3 cashback for PayLah! users at participating hawker stalls.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: Notable initiatives like DBS' "5 Million Hawker Meals" programme offer $3 cashback for PayLah! users at participating hawker stalls.

sections.label: Amendments to hawker motion
sections.summary: Three amendments are proposed to the Motion, changing wording on reviewing support, helping hawkers, and enabling a fair livelihood.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui
sentences.text: This will ensure that our hawker culture thrives for generations to come.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: There are three amendments proposed by the Member to the Motion.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Amendment No 1: "In line 1, to delete ‘review’ and insert ‘continue its support for hawkers by regularly reviewing’".

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Amendment No 2: "In line 2, to delete the words ‘to provide better support for hawkers’ and insert ‘which will help’".

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Amendment No 3: "At the end of line 3, to add '‘while enabling hawkers to earn a fair livelihood’".

sections.label: Question on Member's amendments
sections.summary: The question is the amendments as moved by the Member.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: The question is the amendments as moved by the Member.

sections.label: NEA survey on stallholder costs
sections.summary: NEA's survey found raw materials and manpower were the main cost drivers for stallholders in 2022, at 56% and 20% of operating costs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: The NEA noted from its survey that raw materials and manpower were the main cost drivers for stallholders in hawker centres, at 56% and 20% of operating costs respectively in 2022.

sections.label: Phasing out price-only tender
sections.summary: The speaker proposes phasing out the price-only tender system entirely, citing a record S$10,158 monthly hawker rental at Marine Parade Central Market and Food Centre.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: In addition, I would also like to propose again we should phase out the price-only tender system entirely.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: I am sure many of you would have seen the new record set for hawker rentals at Marine Parade Central Market and Food Centre, where the vacant unit #01-29 set a new record in the July 2024 tender at S$10,158 per month.

sections.label: Price-Quality Method for tenders
sections.summary: Moving from price-only tender would ease financial pressure on hawkers and consumers and reduce advantage of large franchisors; PQM is used by Town Councils.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Moving from a price-only tender would reduce a significant amount of financial pressure for both hawkers and consumers, and also reduce the current environment that is favourable to large franchisors or those with deep pockets, as opposed to the enterprising and innovative hawkers starting out on their own.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: The Price-Quality Method (PQM) is a method which many Town Councils, such as Sengkang Town Council, routinely use to evaluate tender bids in order to more holistically evaluate the merits of the proposals.

sections.label: Markets and hawker centres managed
sections.summary: NEA manages more than 100 markets and hawker centres, with about 13 SEHCs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: At present, there are more than 100 markets and hawker centres managed by NEA with about 13 SEHCs.

sections.label: Onerous SEHC operator contracts
sections.summary: Some SEHC operators impose onerous contracts on hawkers, including recurring POS payments, strict terms, liquidated damages, and loyalty app support requirements.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Certain SEHC operators impose highly onerous contracts in the pages, which are to the detriment of hawkers rather than being supportive of them.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: These include monthly payments for an expensive POS system on a recurring basis compared to them purchasing their own at a lower cost over a period of time, strict terms and conditions, including the imposition of liquidated damages for a long list of terms and conditions, such as business hours and stall closures without written notices, failure to support their loyalty app or even broad-based terms, such as the refusal to cooperate with the landlord.

sections.label: Hawker food price rise and Budget Meals
sections.summary: Hawker food prices rose 6.1% in 2023 due to higher input costs; Budget Meal Programme aims for affordable options at 374 HDB rented eating houses by 2026.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Nevertheless, the increase in business costs borne by our hawkers has ostensibly trickled down to diners, who are already squeezed by rising costs elsewhere.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: This is best exemplified by the staggering 6.1% hike in hawker food prices in 2023 which, according to the Singapore Department of Statistics, could be attributed to higher input costs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: The Government’s approach to tame the rise in hawker food prices is through the introduction of the Budget Meal Programme, which aims to have all 374 HDB rented eating houses provide at least four meal options priced at $3.50 and below, and two drink items priced at $1.20 and below by 2026.

sections.label: CDC Vouchers and CHAS expansion
sections.summary: CDC Vouchers help reduce out-of-pocket food and grocery costs; one suggestion is expanding the CHAS card scheme to cover meal discounts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: The Government has introduced CDC Vouchers to be used at participating merchants, which would help reduce the out-of-pocket costs when purchasing food or groceries.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: To ameliorate this, one suggestion would be to expand the pre-existing CHAS card scheme to effectively cover meal discounts to residents.

sections.label: Food delivery platform fees
sections.summary: A 2020 Zaobao article reports GrabFood, Foodpanda and Deliveroo charge platform fees around 30% of menu price, with 2022 market shares of 56%, 35% and 8%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: A 2020 Zaobao article reports that the platform fees charged by the trio of GrabFood, Foodpanda and Deliveroo – with market shares of 56%, 35% and 8% respectively as of 2022 – hover at around 30% of the menu price.

sections.label: Median age of hawkers
sections.summary: The median age of hawkers was said to be 60 in 2019, and no updated data has been published since.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: For instance, the median age of hawkers was said to be 60 years old in 2019.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: The Government has not, to my understanding, published any updated data on this since, but I do not think the number has changed significantly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: This means that half of Singapore's hawkers are at most three years away from the current age of retirement.

sections.label: Hawkers' Development Programme enrolment
sections.summary: 566 aspiring hawkers enrolled, 120 completed apprenticeship, 29 started business, 16 remain; seven veteran hawkers joined the Hawkers Succession Scheme, two completed transfers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: In response to my PQs, since the launch of the Hawkers' Development Programme to much fanfare, 566 aspiring hawkers have enrolled, 120 completed their apprenticeship and an even smaller number of 29 have started their business and a mere 16 of them remain in operation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Of the Hawkers Succession Scheme, since its launch on 1 January 2022, a grand total of seven veteran hawkers have signed up and of these only two have completed the transfer of their stalls to their successors.

sections.label: Foreign work pass holders for hawkers
sections.summary: A middle-ground approach allowing hawkers above 60 to employ one foreign work pass holder per stall should be studied, and the MSE was asked if it quantified the LTVP impact.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Perhaps a middle-ground approach, allowing hawkers above the age of 60 to employ one foreign work pass holder, at most per stall, should be studied.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: I recognise that the Government has stated in its reply to a PQ that it will "allow hawkers to hire LTVP or LTVP+ holders with Letters of Consent (LOC) or Pre-approved LOCs to work as their stall assistants.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: This policy will be effective from 1 Jan 2025".

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Has the MSE quantified the impact of this move?

sections.label: Measures to alleviate hawker manpower shortage
sections.summary: The joint tenancy scheme lets hawkers work shorter hours and share rental cost, stall holders can hire from a bigger pool of LTVP holders, and centralised common services reduce manpower required.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: For instance, the joint tenancy scheme allows hawkers to work shorter hours and share rental cost with co-tenants.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Also, to alleviate manpower shortage, stall holders can now hire from a bigger pool of LTVP holders.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Apart from that, centralised common services scheme like dish washing, clearing of crockery and cutlery, and general cleaning can reduce the manpower required.

sections.label: Budget meals at Bukit Canberra Hawker Centre
sections.summary: All 44 stalls at Bukit Canberra Hawker Centre offer $3.50 budget meals, with quantity and ingredients usually more budgeted to fit the price cap.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: In Bukit Canberra Hawker Centre, all 44 stalls offer $3.50 budget meals and the meals' quantity and ingredients are usually more budgeted as well to fit into the price cap.

sections.label: Belanja-A-Meal free meals scheme
sections.summary: Low-income residents on the Belanja-A-Meal scheme can each enjoy 10 free meals monthly, thanks to contributions from residents and donors.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Thanks to contributions from fellow residents and generous donors, low-income residents on Belanja-A-Meal scheme can each enjoy 10 free meals monthly.

sections.label: Belanja-A-Meal free meals
sections.summary: Low-income residents under the Belanja-A-Meal scheme can enjoy 10 free meals per month with contributions from residents and donors.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: With contributions from residents and generous donors, low-income residents under the Belanja-A-Meal scheme can enjoy 10 free meals per month.

sections.label: Hawkers Succession Scheme take-up
sections.summary: The 2022 Hawkers Succession Scheme helps retiring veteran hawkers pass skills, recipes and stalls to successors, but take-up remains low.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: In 2022, the Hawkers Succession Scheme was launched to help retiring veteran hawkers pass their culinary skills, recipes and hawker stalls to aspiring successors.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Unfortunately, the take-up rate for these schemes to establish a more systematic framework to attract and develop aspiring hawkers is still low till date.

sections.label: Hawker competition prize and support
sections.summary: The competition prize can include free rental at a stall of the winner's choice, and Enterprise Singapore and NEA could jointly help hawkers lacking funds.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: The competition prize can include a free rental for a period, at a stall of the winner’s choice.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: My second suggestion is for Enterprise Singapore and NEA to jointly help enterprising hawkers who do not have the funds to promote and expand their business and operations within Singapore and overseas.

sections.label: Singaporeans eating hawker food
sections.summary: An NEA study in 2023 suggests over 80% of Singaporeans consume hawker centre food at least once a week.

sentences.speaker: Mr Keith Chua (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: An NEA study in 2023 suggests that over 80% of Singaporeans consume hawker centre food at least once a week.

sections.label: Subsidised Rent Scheme and bids
sections.summary: Older hawkers benefit from the Subsidised Rent Scheme, about 40% of cooked food stallholders, and average successful bids stay below food court and coffee shop rentals.

sentences.speaker: Mr Keith Chua (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Older hawkers continue to benefit from the Subsidised Rent Scheme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Keith Chua (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: NEA data estimates this at about 40% of cooked food stallholders.

sentences.speaker: Mr Keith Chua (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: NEA also reports that the average successful monthly bid for cooked food stalls continues to be lower than rental at food courts and coffee shops.

sections.label: Proposed bidding system change
sections.summary: The proposal by Mr Leong and Ms Poa will not be perfect and could result in vacancies, while the current bidding system awards a stall for a minimum of $1 if highest.

sentences.speaker: Mr Keith Chua (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: And this has been proposed by hon Members Mr Leong and Ms Poa.

sentences.speaker: Mr Keith Chua (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: This, too, will not be perfect and could result in potential vacancies, whereas the current bidding system will still award a stall for a minimum of $1 rental if this is the highest bid.

sections.label: Hawker culture UNESCO listing
sections.summary: Hawker culture was successfully included in the UNESCO Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity.

sentences.speaker: Mr Keith Chua (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: On a national level, there has been the successful inclusion of hawker culture in the UNESCO Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity.

sections.label: Hawker grants and succession
sections.summary: Hawkers have grants for equipment and going digital, and succession is a big challenge for the industry.

sentences.speaker: Mr Keith Chua (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Hawkers also have opportunities to improve processes and these include grants for equipment and going digital.

sentences.speaker: Mr Keith Chua (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: One big challenge for the hawker industry is that of succession.

sections.label: KEK Seafood second generation
sections.summary: KEK Seafood is a family that transitioned into the second generation, growing from a stall to a multi-outlet restaurant business.

sentences.speaker: Mr Keith Chua (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: KEK Seafood is one example of a family that has successfully transitioned into the second generation, having grown from a stall to now, a multi-outlet restaurant business.

sections.label: Perception and affordable meals
sections.summary: Public perception of hawkers and cheap food expectations may need to evolve while access to good, affordable meals is ensured.

sentences.speaker: Mr Keith Chua (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Public perception of hawkers and the expectation of cheap food may well need to evolve.

sentences.speaker: Mr Keith Chua (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: However, we also want to try to ensure that access to good and affordable meals remains available and accessible for those who need this option, as we work on raising income levels.

sections.label: Reviewing hawker centre policy
sections.summary: At the first Environment GPC meeting in 2011, the ask was to review hawker centre policy and consider resuming building new hawker centres.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: And I know him to be a Minister who has always been open-minded about new policy ideas or policy changes, and that he has no hesitation to move if he feels that it is the right thing to do.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: Hence, on our first Environment Government Parliamentary Committee (GPC) meeting with him in 2011, I remember my first ask to him at that meeting was to review the hawker centre policy and to consider resuming the building of new hawker centres.

sections.label: Resuming hawker centre building
sections.summary: Lower entry barriers and running costs help hawker businesses, and in 2011 the Cabinet resumed building hawker centres, with 10 announced.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: With lower barrier to entry and lower running costs, it helps improve the viability of hawker trade businesses and keeps the hawker trade and its food culture alive.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: So, I am glad, in 2011, that then-Minister Vivian was able to finally persuade the Cabinet to resume building hawker centres and the first 10 new hawker centres were announced – with the first one being built in Bukit Panjang, although I must declare, I was not the Member of Parliament there yet.

sections.label: New hawker centres added
sections.summary: 14 new hawker centres were added since 2011, with six more planned by 2027, and NEA directly managed 121 existing centres and markets.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: At my last count, we have added 14 new hawker centres since 2011, with six more in the pipeline to be built by 2027.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: NEA still directly managed the existing 121 hawker centres and markets.

sections.label: Programmes to encourage hawkers
sections.summary: Numbers are not enough to replace earlier hawkers, so the Government introduced programmes like the Incubation Stall Programme and Hawkers Succession Scheme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: But clearly, the numbers are still not enough to replace the earlier generations of hawkers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: This is a serious challenge to the hawker trade and to our hawker culture.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: In recent years, the Government introduced a number of programmes with the aim to encourage more to join the hawker trade, such as the Incubation Stall Programme to assist aspiring hawkers with pre-fitted equipment to lower the startup cost; Hawkers Succession Scheme, which aims to assist veteran hawkers who intend to retire but are unable to find successors, to pass down their skills, recipes and hawker stalls to aspiring hawkers and which also come with a generous $23,000 ex-gratia payment as well as monthly stipend in the initial months.

sections.label: LTVP+ holders for hawkers
sections.summary: Dr Koh Poh Koon announced NEA will relax the manpower policy to allow hawkers to hire LTVP+ holders in January next year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: Senior Minister of State Dr Koh Poh Koon announced last month that NEA will be relaxing the manpower policy to allow hawkers to hire LTVP+ holders in January next year.

sections.label: Hawkers Productivity Grant funding
sections.summary: The Hawkers Productivity Grant helped individual hawkers with 80% co-funding to buy kitchen automation equipment and digital solutions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: The Hawkers Productivity Grant has also helped individual hawkers with 80% co-funding to purchase kitchen automation equipment and digital solutions.

sections.label: Hawker food prices and costs
sections.summary: Hawker food prices rose 6.1% in 2023, and MSE said ingredients and manpower were the main cost drivers, 70% to 80% of expenditure.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: Data from the Department of Statistics showed that hawker food prices rose by 6.1% in 2023 and the increase is broad-based.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: In response to a recent PQ that I filed, MSE replied that based on NEA's surveys, the main cost drivers for stallholders were ingredients and manpower, which combined, account for 70% to 80% of the hawkers' expenditure.

sections.label: Hawker stall rents and tenders
sections.summary: Koh Poh Koon said outlier high tender bids are not the norm, median rent averaged around $1,200 monthly, and NEA will stagger downward rental adjustments.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: Senior Minister of State Koh Poh Koon had taken pains to explain to the House at last month’s Sitting that outlier high tender bids are not the norm and that the median rent typically average around $1,200 per month in the last 10 years, as per his recent speech, And some subsidised stallholders pay about $300 per month.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: NEA allocates stalls on price-based tender basis, with no reserve bid price.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: So, stall rentals can go below $100 per month, including to as low as $1 in the past, as it had happened before in the past.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: I note the announcement last month that NEA will stagger the downward rental adjustments over a longer period, after three years, referencing the Assessed Market Rent.

sections.label: Top bid rent evaluation
sections.summary: NEA can carry out a deeper evaluation of bidders when the top bid rent price significantly deviates from the Assessed Market Rent.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: For example, in the event that of top bid rent price, that significantly deviates from the Assessed Market Rent, NEA can carry out a deeper evaluation on the bidders on whether the bidder really has the means and the capability to sustain their business with such a high rental rates?

sections.label: Options after market fire
sections.summary: With South West CDC help, emergency relief funds were provided, and two options were faced: a temporary market or a faster rebuild.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
sentences.text: With the help of South West CDC, we were able to quickly provide emergency relief funds to support them through those first difficult days.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
sentences.text: We faced two options: either construct a temporary market within six to 12 months or undertake a faster rebuild of the burnt market back to the original condition, which would take 12 to 18 months.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
sentences.text: Building a temporary market would cost about $750,000 – a daunting figure that we would have to fundraise.

sections.label: Temporary market and Jurong Central Plaza
sections.summary: Funds were raised and a temporary market built in six weeks; stallholders returned by end 2016, and Jurong Central Plaza opened on 1 January 2019.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
sentences.text: Together, we took on the challenge and, against all odds, raised the funds and built the temporary market in just six weeks – much faster than industry experts had predicted.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
sentences.text: By the end of 2016, the stallholders were back in business.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
sentences.text: And on 1 January 2019, we opened the new market and eating house known as the Jurong Central Plaza, a two-storey complex that also includes a Senior Day Care Centre on the upper floor, providing valuable services to our elderly community members.

sections.label: Focus on cooked food stalls
sections.summary: The decision was made to focus solely on cooked food stalls, using the ground and second levels with escalator access.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
sentences.text: With this insight, we made the decision to focus solely on cooked food stalls, making use of both the ground and second levels with easy access via escalators.

sections.label: Jurong Central market fire
sections.summary: In October 2016, a fire at the Jurong Central market and food centre caused 56 stallholders to instantly lose their livelihoods.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
sentences.text: (In Mandarin):   Mr Speaker, in October 2016, when a fire broke out at the market and food centre in Jurong Central, 56 stallholders instantly lost their livelihoods.

sections.label: Six-week construction completion
sections.summary: Construction estimated at six months was completed in six weeks, and affected stallholders reopened from the October fire to around Christmas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
sentences.text: What was originally estimated to take six months of construction was completed successfully in six weeks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
sentences.text: From the fire in October to around Christmas at the end of December, the affected stallholders were able to reopen their businesses.

sections.label: Jurong Central building opening
sections.summary: The new two-storey Jurong Central building officially opened on 1 January 2019 after a two-year transition period.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
sentences.text: After a two-year transition period, the new two-storey Jurong Central building finally officially opened on 1 January 2019, providing hawkers with a brand new and more spacious business venue, as well as a more comfortable shopping and dining environment for our residents.

sections.label: Jurong West Hawker Centre layout
sections.summary: The new Jurong West Hawker Centre placed cooked-food stalls on both the first and second floors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
sentences.text: The new Jurong West Hawker Centre broke away from the previous design of having cooked-food stalls only on the second floor and instead placed them on both the first and second floors, offering more diverse choices and better visibility.

sections.label: Hawker support measures and CDC Vouchers
sections.summary: Measures include revised rent control, hawker training programmes, the Hawkers' Productivity Grant, Hawkers Go Digital and CDC Vouchers extended to all Singaporean households.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: Some have been fairly successful and some not so, but I know the Government is closely looking at these.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: These include the revised rent control measures, a suite of hawker training programmes to increase the replacement rate of hawkers, the Hawkers' Productivity Grant and the Hawkers Go Digital Programme; and of course, the ongoing CDC Vouchers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: In fact, the budget for CDC Vouchers, originally intended only for lower-income households, was substantially increased after the Mayors appealed and worked with the Ministry of Finance to extend them to every Singaporean household.

sections.label: NEA tiering and managing iconic centres
sections.summary: The speaker proposes NEA tier hawker centres and coffee shops and manage key iconic hawker centres serving mostly non-residents.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: These prominent centres managed by Town Councils require substantial maintenance to uphold the standards expected of national landmarks, yet the Town Councils often lack the necessary funds and specialised management expertise.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: So, in light of these challenges, I propose that NEA categorise or tier the types of hawker centres and even coffee shops and allocate its resources and expertise accordingly.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: I do not think that NEA should take over the running of all hawker centres, but I do urge NEA to assume responsibility for managing and maintaining key national iconic hawker centres, such as Albert Centre, People's Park and Chinatown Complex, that serve mostly non-residents versus residents.

sections.label: Survey on not wanting hawker work
sections.summary: A 2024 survey cited found 87% of respondents do not want to be hawkers, citing long hours and lack of interest.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: In a survey quoted in a 2024 Lee Kwan Yew School of Public Policy article, "Cooking or Cooked: The Future of Singapore's Hawker Culture", 87% of respondents stated they do not want to be hawkers, quoting long working hours and lack of interest.

sections.label: Support for amended Motion
sections.summary: The speaker calls for joint effort to keep the heritage accessible and affordable, and supports the Motion as amended by Edward Chia.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: The root issues of declining margins and the reluctance of younger Singaporeans to enter this industry are not easy to resolve and need to be recognised.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: So, let us work together – Government agencies, Town Councils, social enterprises, hawkers and citizens – to ensure that this heritage remains accessible and affordable for generations to come.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: With this, I support the Motion as amended by hon Member Edward Chia.

sections.label: Government hawker support programmes
sections.summary: The Government introduced supply-side and demand-side programmes to help hawkers, including the Hawker Development Programme, grants, assistance and CDC Vouchers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar (Sembawang)
sentences.text: The Government has introduced many programmes to help, such as, on the supply side, the Hawker Development Programme, Hawker's Productivity Grant; and targeted rental, financial and skills development assistance; on the demand side, we are all familiar with the CDC Vouchers scheme.

sentences.speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar (Sembawang)
sentences.text: For example, the recent move to allow hawkers to hire workers on LTVPs in order to relieve manpower shortages.

sections.label: BAM@Woodlands free meals programme
sections.summary: During COVID-19, BAM@Woodlands began at Kampung Admiralty Hawker Centre and division coffee shops, letting people buy or donate meals for low-income residents.

sentences.speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar (Sembawang)
sentences.text: In Woodlands, during the COVID-19 pandemic, I started our Belanja-A-Meal @ Woodlands or BAM@Woodlands programme at Kampung Admiralty Hawker Centre and coffee shops in my division.

sentences.speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar (Sembawang)
sentences.text: People can buy extra meals at over 30 participating hawker stalls or make an online donation, while low-income residents can redeem free meals of their choice – 10 meals a month for each member of their family.

sections.label: Hawker stalls give extra value
sections.summary: Many hawker stalls give more value than the $4 paid for each BAM meal.

sentences.speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Many of our hawker stalls give more value than the $4 we pay them for each BAM meal.

sections.label: Fundraising for Ah Ji's bills
sections.summary: Within a week, $200,000 was raised to help Ah Ji pay for hospital bills and rehabilitation.

sentences.speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Within a week, it raised $200,000 to help Ah Ji pay for his hospital bills and rehabilitation.

sections.label: BAM meal redemptions and pricing
sections.summary: Over 70,000 free meals have been redeemed, stalls absorbed price increases, and the $4 payment per meal will be revised.

sentences.speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar (Sembawang)
sentences.text: To date, more than 70,000 free meals have been redeemed, with more beneficiaries joining the programme every month.

sentences.speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Despite their own costs going up, many stalls have absorbed the price increases without requiring our BAM@Woodlands beneficiaries to top up the difference.

sentences.speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar (Sembawang)
sentences.text: But I do not take our hawkers for granted and will be revising the $4 we pay them for each meal in the new year.

sections.label: BAM@Woodlands launch purpose
sections.summary: BAM@Woodlands was launched during COVID-19 to support hawkers with impacted businesses and give residents in need free meals of their choice.

sentences.speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Initiatives like BAM@Woodlands are a good example of this.

sentences.speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar (Sembawang)
sentences.text: We launched BAM@Woodlands during COVID-19 to support our hawkers whose businesses were impacted and to provide our residents in need with free meals of their choice.

sections.label: Free meals to families
sections.summary: Over four years, more than 70,000 free meals were provided to hundreds of families.

sentences.speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Over the past four years, it has provided more than 70,000 free meals to hundreds of families.

sections.label: Kuih raya donation by hawker
sections.summary: Mdm Suryati Pokol, who ran Warung Lorong Fatimah, donated over 100 bottles of kuih raya to a donation drive.

sentences.speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar (Sembawang)
sentences.text: For example, Mdm Suryati Pokol, who ran Warung Lorong Fatimah at Kampung Admiralty Hawker Centre, donated more than 100 bottles of kuih raya to our kuih raya donation drive.

sections.label: Ramadan BAM free buka puasa
sections.summary: For four Ramadans, Woodlands Community Centre used BAM to provide 1,000 free buka puasa meals weekly at halal hawker stalls.

sentences.speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar (Sembawang)
sentences.text: For the past four Ramadans, Woodlands Community Centre has used the BAM platform to provide 1,000 free buka puasa meals every week at our halal hawker stalls.

sentences.speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Ramadan BAM is open to people of all races and backgrounds, to share in the spirit of giving of iftar which as Muslims we believe multiplies our fasts and rewards.

sentences.speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar (Sembawang)
sentences.text: This programme has also helped to introduce new stalls to our residents, such as when the halal food court Cantine opened at Admiralty Place.

sentences.speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar (Sembawang)
sentences.text: By expanding programmes like these, we, the community, can help ensure that our hawker centres continue to be vibrant, inclusive spaces that reflect the Singapore spirit. : Mr Speaker, in conclusion, our hawker centres are a symbol of our shared history and values, where we find comfort and community.

sections.label: Preserving hawker culture together
sections.summary: Working together to preserve hawker culture lets future generations enjoy and contribute to it.

sentences.speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar (Sembawang)
sentences.text: If we care enough about it, we must work together to preserve this precious part of our identity, so that future generations can continue to enjoy and contribute to a vibrant hawker culture.

sections.label: MAS tightened monetary policy
sections.summary: The Monetary Authority of Singapore acted quickly to tighten monetary policy five times.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Finance (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong)
sentences.text: The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) acted quickly to tighten monetary policy five times.

sections.label: Enhanced Assurance Package payouts
sections.summary: The Assurance Package was enhanced to more than $10 billion, comprising cash payouts, MediSave top-ups, CDC Vouchers, U-Save and S&CC rebates.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Finance (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong)
sentences.text: Hence, we have enhanced the Assurance Package several times since it was first introduced in 2022, to help Singaporeans cope with rising costs of living.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Finance (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong)
sentences.text: And today, we have enhanced the Assurance Package to more than $10 billion, comprising cash payouts, MediSave top-ups, CDC Vouchers as well as additional U-Save and S&CC rebates.

sections.label: CDC Vouchers and Cash Payouts
sections.summary: In January 2025, every Singaporean household will receive another $300 in CDC Vouchers, and all adult Singaporeans will receive $200 to $600 in cash payouts.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Finance (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong)
sentences.text: In January 2025, every Singaporean household will receive another $300 in CDC Vouchers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Finance (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong)
sentences.text: In the coming months, all adult Singaporeans will also receive between $200 and $600 in cash payouts.

sections.label: Support for Middle-Income Households
sections.summary: A middle-income household with two young children will get about $4,400 in rebates, payouts and support this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Finance (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong)

sections.label: Monitoring SEHC model rollout
sections.summary: As the SEHC model is rolled out to more new hawker centres, implementation will be monitored and NEA will work with hawkers and operators.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: As we roll out the SEHC model to more new hawker centres, we will continue to monitor the implementation of the SEHC model closely and work with hawkers and operators to ensure that our new hawker centres continue to serve the interests of patrons well and ensure the well-being of our hawkers.

sections.label: Inflation concerns and hawker pricing
sections.summary: Many Singaporeans are concerned about global inflation's impact on cost of living, but hawkers must set reasonable prices to earn a decent income.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: Many Singaporeans are concerned about the impact of global inflation on the cost of living.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: However, for hawkers to earn a decent income, they must consider the reality and set reasonable prices for their food.

sections.label: Hawker policy review and culture
sections.summary: The Government will keep listening to feedback and reviewing policies to sustain hawkers' livelihoods, attract younger Singaporeans, and preserve local hawker culture from franchises.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: The Government is committed to continue listening to feedback and to review and improve relevant policies with an open mind, with the aim to ensure hawkers' livelihoods and the long-term sustainability of the hawker trade and attract younger generations of Singaporeans to join this profession.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: Of these many goals, one is also to preserve our unique local hawker culture and ensure it is not replaced by franchises.

sections.label: Supporting hawker culture together
sections.summary: It calls for working together to support and protect hawker culture so it can thrive for generations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: Let us work together to support and protect our hawker culture, so that it can thrive for generations to come.

sections.label: Audit of operator earnings
sections.summary: NEA will audit operators' actual earnings, and 50% of extra profits must fund programmes enhancing hawker centre activities, to prevent profiteering.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: If there are any extra profits that they gain, 50% of it must then, as I said in my main reply, be put into providing programmes that enhance the activities of the hawker centre.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: So, there will be an audit conducted by NEA on their actual earnings so that we can make that decision and make sure that there is no extra profiteering involved.

sections.label: Guidelines and operator penalties
sections.summary: NEA will penalise operators whose contracts violate guidelines, and egregious offenders may be denied contract renewal.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: I think the guidelines are meant to guide the behaviour between the operator and the hawkers that are working at this hawker centre.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: So, if there are issues in which the contract that is drafted is actually in violation of the guidelines, NEA will take a look at it and give relevant penalties.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Or should the offence be egregious, at the next contract renewal term, this operator will not be favourably looked upon and the operator will not be able to get the next contract renewal.

sections.label: Second price tender pilot
sections.summary: It asks whether the Government could pilot second price tenders, where the highest bidder wins but pays the second bid.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
sentences.text: In a similar vein, given concerns about the highest price bidder actually winning the tender, could the Government also consider a pilot whereby it could consider second price tenders instead, whereby the winner will still be the highest bidder, but they will pay the second bid?

sections.label: LTVP+ hawker labour source
sections.summary: It says society's acceptance may change as the population ages and workforce dwindles, and LTVP+ now expands potential labour for hawkers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: It is about what society can accept over time as the population ages, workforce dwindles and the nature of hawker centres may evolve and the society is prepared to accept.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: But now we have just made a move to liberalise through LTVP+.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: So, that provides an additional expanded source of potential labour that the hawkers can tap into.

sections.label: Highest bidder for stalls
sections.summary: The speaker says the highest bidder should be given the stall, and outlier bids are rare, with one in the last five years.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Because I think to be fair and transparent, the highest bidder actually should be the one to be given the stall.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: But as I said, if the concern is about outlier bids, today, the outlier bids are a rare occurrence.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In fact, the one that got everybody's attention is actually the only one in the last five years.

sections.label: Support for hawker culture motion
sections.summary: The speaker thanks the Workers' Party for supporting PSP's points and notes agreement on safeguarding hawker culture and helping hawkers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai
sentences.text: I also thank the Workers' Party for supporting most of the points that PSP has raised.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai
sentences.text: I am glad that based on the amended Motion put forward by Mr Edward Chia, all of us have agreed on the importance of safeguarding our hawker culture, which is an important national institution and cultural inheritance, and the need to provide help to our hawkers to continue to provide good and affordable food and earn a fair livelihood at the same time.

sections.label: Social enterprise model incompatible
sections.summary: PSP views the corporatised social enterprise model as incompatible with the free sole proprietor spirit of individual hawkers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai
sentences.text: In PSP's view, we think that the corporatised culture of a social enterprise model is actually not compatible with the free sole proprietor spirit of individual hawkers.

sections.label: Tender renewal system questioned
sections.summary: PSP questions why the tender system needs a renewal system where a high bid is reduced to a lower Assessed Market Rent after three years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai
sentences.text: The second point, while we appreciate the advantages that Senior Minister of State Koh has shared with us about the tender system, there is still an unanswered question as to why is there a need for the system to also cater for a renewal system that is so peculiar, specifically, a high tender bid will be reduced to a lower Assessed Market Rent after the initial three years.

sections.label: Work Permit holders for hawkers
sections.summary: PSP disagrees that coffee shops and food courts may employ Work Permit holders while individual hawkers may not.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai
sentences.text: The third point, we also disagree that while you allow the coffee shops and the food courts to employ Work Permit holders, you do not allow the individual hawkers to do so.

sections.label: Six policy changes for hawkers
sections.summary: PSP believes six policy changes will revitalise hawker culture, but individual hawkers face high rentals, manpower shortages and corporatised competition, risking decline.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai
sentences.text: PSP believes these six policy changes will revitalise our hawker culture, making Singapore's hawker food shine brighter on the international stage while ensuring hawker centres continue to provide affordable food for Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai
sentences.text: Singapore's Pioneer hawkers have provided us with good quality, affordable food through hard work and low profits.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai
sentences.text: But under current pressures of high rentals, manpower shortages and competition from corporatised hawkers, individual hawkers face enormous challenges.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai
sentences.text: At the current rate, traditional hawker culture based on individual hawkers' diligence and entrepreneurial spirit will gradually decline.

sections.label: Hawker support amendments proposed
sections.summary: The House is asked to decide on three amendments by Mr Edward Chia concerning support for hawkers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: I shall put the questions on the amendments to the House for decision.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: We have three amendments proposed by Member Mr Edward Chia.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Amendment No 1, in line 1, to delete "review" and insert "continue its support for hawkers by regularly reviewing".

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Amendment No 2, in line 2, to delete the words "to provide better support for hawkers" and insert ", which will help".

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Amendment No 3, at the end of line 3, to add "while enabling hawkers to earn a fair livelihood".
